qualifications: The 154 Al-Qadim walkthrough turns duplicate its second production panel. Unique-game counts collapse only that exact panel identity.

12 justified declines preserve objective-only source limits; no unsupported procedure is counted as a real answer.
All116 strict failures and9 recovered passes were explicitly reviewed. Other880 strict passes are not independently adjudicated; passing scores do not establish exhaustive six-game understanding.
